[whoami] The signed-in GitHub user.

GET {{GITHUB}}/user
Authorization: Bearer $token
Accept: application/vnd.github+json

HTTP 200
---
[get-repo] One repository.

GET {{GITHUB}}/repos/$owner/$repo
Authorization: Bearer $token
Accept: application/vnd.github+json

HTTP 200
---
[list-issues] Open issues in a repository.

GET {{GITHUB}}/repos/$owner/$repo/issues?state=open
Authorization: Bearer $token
Accept: application/vnd.github+json

HTTP 200
